h1: Crypto payments for gaming & iGaming platforms with zero chargeback risk
subheading: Accept 15+ cryptocurrencies from players worldwide, eliminate payment friction, and receive funds directly to your wallet—no intermediaries.
intro_paragraph: Gaming and iGaming operators face constant payment challenges: card processors block or restrict accounts, chargebacks drain revenue, and players face endless card declines. Dynopay is a non-custodial platform that lets you accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and 12+ other cryptocurrencies. You receive funds directly in your wallet—Dynopay never holds your money—and payments settle in minutes with fees starting at 1.5% that drop to 0.5% at scale. No chargebacks. No monthly fees.

features.title: Zero chargeback exposure
features.description: Crypto transactions are final. No fraudulent disputes or friendly-fraud reversals eating into revenue, and no dispute-management overhead or representment fees to absorb.

features.title: One payment rail for every market
features.description: Accept crypto from players across the markets where you operate—one integration instead of a patchwork of regional processors and banking relationships. You stay in charge of your own licensing and market rules.

features.title: Direct wallet settlements
features.description: Receive funds straight to your Ethereum, Bitcoin, or USDT wallet within minutes. Dynopay never holds your money, so you maintain full custody and can access capital immediately.

how_it_works: Sign up, verify your email, and create your company profile in under three minutes.
Add your Bitcoin, Ethereum, or stablecoin wallet address where you want to receive player deposits.
Generate payment links or embed the checkout widget on your platform and start accepting crypto.

faqs.question: Do crypto payments for gaming have chargebacks?
faqs.answer: No. Cryptocurrency transactions are irreversible by design. Once a player sends a deposit, they cannot dispute or reverse it, eliminating chargeback fraud and the dispute losses gaming operators face from card payments.

faqs.question: What cryptocurrencies can gaming platforms accept with Dynopay?
faqs.answer: Dynopay supports 15+ cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, USDT on Ethereum, Polygon and Tron, USDC, SOL, XRP, RLUSD, and others. Players choose their preferred coin at checkout.

faqs.question: How much does Dynopay charge for gaming crypto payments?
faqs.answer: Fees start at 1.5% plus one dollar per transaction and automatically drop to 0.5% as your settled volume grows. No monthly fees, no setup costs, and your first payment is completely free. No chargebacks mean no dispute fees.

faqs.question: Can players from different countries deposit with crypto?
faqs.answer: Crypto payments work globally, so players across the markets where your platform operates can deposit without card declines or regional processor gaps. Identity verification (KYC) applies to your Dynopay account once settled volume passes a threshold, and fiat off-ramps run their own KYC.

faqs.question: How quickly can a gaming site start accepting crypto with Dynopay?
faqs.answer: Most operators go live in under 10 minutes. Sign up, verify your email, add your payout wallet address, and generate a payment link or embed the checkout widget. No lengthy processor underwriting—your own gaming licences and local compliance remain your responsibility.

cta_body: Your first payment is free. No monthly fees, no setup costs, and live in under 10 minutes with zero chargeback risk.
